discrete_reference_values.formulation: SWBPIPE's stated formulation at 8 members: Hermitian consistent mass with Rayleigh rotary inertia, no shear deformation. Units m, N, N*m, Hz. Each value is the reference's nearest binary64; the file holds 40 significant digits
discrete_reference_values.note: combined magnitudes are unsigned. The comparable setting is srss; the other rules are quoted for the declared variants, and correspond only where the other program's rule is the same rule (the closeness tests and correlation coefficient are stated in the reference's README)
discrete_reference_values.request: spectrum along global Y, flat 2.5 m/s^2, the first 6 modes, no missing mass, one direction
discrete_reference_values.source: validation/references/f2_spectrum/discrete/c9_pipe_diagonal.json, case C9-PIPE-DIAGONAL (pull request 268; not yet on main)
discrete_reference_values.source_status: references with a refutation record: REFUTATION.md in this directory

mode_count_basis.note: the response is truncated at these modes on both sides alike; no missing mass is requested
mode_count_basis.what: SWBPIPE's own modal solve of this model (in-crate, the production criteria, branch head c8c602df6; an experimental surface, not a released result and NOT a reference value). Given so the mode count can be seen to cut at a wide gap and to hold no repeated cluster
